propositions: A completion close reads HEAD independently for verify and sign, so a commit landing in the verify→sign window splits them and the ticket closes without a completion attestation.
On drift the verifier refuses to attest the stale tree but the close transition proceeds anyway, leaving the ticket permanently closed with only a plan-review attestation.
The suggested remedy to 're-close to certify' is a no-op because the ticket is already closed, leaving only --force-close or manual sign fabrication as recovery.
The fix should pin one revision for the whole verify+sign+close unit, or abort the close and leave the ticket in_progress (retryable) on drift.
A first-class non-force recovery (e.g. rebar reverify-completion) is needed to obtain the completion attestation for a closed-but-unsigned ticket.
The 80af --ref fix only made the non-default path coherent; the default no-ref path still reads HEAD twice and splits.
